request_parameters.captured_scope: Audited public-demo subset for Hyde Park, St. James's Park and Kensington Gardens

filtering_rules: Use entrance=*, routing:entrance=* and barrier=gate tags on nodes that are members of the associated green-space boundary.
Exclude access=no/private, foot=no/private and service, emergency or exit-only entries before runtime exposure.
Treat missing access as uncertain; entrance and barrier tags do not prove public access rights.
Prefer routing:entrance=main/main_entrance, then entrance=main/main_entrance, then explicit-public access and stable OSM identity.
Never generate an entrance from a polygon centroid, interior sample or nearest road point.
fixture_coverage: explicitly prohibited nodes excluded during processing
candidate sites with no valid entrance
known_limitations: The committed snapshot is an intentionally small, audited London demo subset, not complete entrance coverage for every London green space.
A full saved-query refresh was attempted but the public Overpass response terminated before completion; live runtime never compensates with an unbounded Overpass call.
OSM entrance tags identify mapped physical access points, not legal access rights or guaranteed opening.
Community-maintained access, foot, wheelchair and opening-hours tags may be incomplete or outdated.
Only boundary-member associations are accepted, so nearby unassociated gates are deliberately omitted.
